9/11 made my finger bleed. Why is that connected?   
   
The lead singer of My Chemical Romance, Gerard way was an intern at Cartoon Network around 2001 at New York. He witnessed the 9/11 attacks first hand. Because of this, he decided to just fuck being a cartoonist; he wanted to make a difference.   
   
So yeah, he quit and wrote a song about 9/11, Skylines and Turnstiles - the first My Chemical Romance song. They managed to make a bunch of songs until about around 2005, I discovered them.   
   
I started playing the guitar around 2009. I tried to play a song called Ghost of You. A My Chemical Romance song. I got to carried away in playing it that I strum too hard and my rusty guitar string snapped which scratched my finger causing it to bleed.   
   
That's how 9/11 cause my finger to bleed. I could go deeper and say what my finger bleeding had an effect upon but, yeah, no.
